translation.example:
from quantreg import rq, predict_rq
fit = rq('y ~ x1 + x2', tau=0.5, data=data)
new = {key: value[:2] for key, value in data.items()}
print(np.concatenate([predict_rq(fit)[:4], predict_rq(fit, new)]))
